name: Metformin
description: A medicine commonly used to help manage blood glucose levels in people with type 2 diabetes.
howItWorks: It reduces glucose production by the liver and helps improve the body's response to insulin.
precautions: Take only according to the prescribed instructions.
Tell a healthcare professional about kidney problems or other medical conditions.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive heat and moisture.

name: Amlodipine
description: A medicine used to treat high blood pressure and certain types of chest pain.
howItWorks: It relaxes and widens blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.
commonSideEffects: Swelling of the ankles or feet
precautions: Use according to the prescribed dose.
Tell a healthcare professional if dizziness or significant swelling occurs.
storage: Store at room temperature away from light and moisture.

name: Losartan
description: A medicine commonly prescribed to help lower high blood pressure.
commonUses: Certain kidney problems associated with type 2 diabetes
howItWorks: It blocks the effects of angiotensin II, helping blood vessels relax and lowering blood pressure.
precautions: Use according to the prescribed instructions.
Tell a healthcare professional about kidney problems or medicines and supplements containing potassium.
storage: Store at room temperature in a dry place protected from excessive moisture.

name: Atorvastatin
description: A cholesterol-lowering medicine used to help reduce levels of certain fats in the blood.
commonUses: Reduction of cardiovascular risk in appropriate patients
howItWorks: It reduces cholesterol production in the liver by blocking an enzyme involved in making cholesterol.
precautions: Take according to the prescribed instructions.
Tell a healthcare professional about unexplained muscle pain or weakness.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive heat and moisture.

name: Omeprazole
description: A medicine that reduces the amount of acid produced by the stomach.
howItWorks: It blocks an enzyme in stomach cells that is involved in producing stomach acid.
precautions: Follow the prescribed instructions and treatment duration.
Discuss prolonged use with a healthcare professional.
storage: Store at room temperature away from heat and moisture.

name: Furosemide
description: A diuretic medicine that helps the body remove excess salt and water through urine.
howItWorks: It acts on the kidneys to increase the removal of sodium and water from the body.
precautions: Use only according to the prescribed instructions.
Tell a healthcare professional about significant dizziness, dehydration, or weakness.
storage: Store at room temperature and protect from excessive light and moisture.

name: Carvedilol
description: A medicine used for certain cardiovascular conditions, including high blood pressure and heart failure.
howItWorks: It blocks certain receptors in the heart and blood vessels, reducing heart rate and helping blood vessels relax.
precautions: Take according to the prescribed instructions.
Do not make sudden changes to treatment without consulting the prescribing healthcare professional.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive heat and moisture.

name: Levothyroxine
description: A synthetic form of thyroid hormone used when the body does not produce enough thyroid hormone.
howItWorks: It replaces or supplements the thyroid hormone normally produced by the thyroid gland.
commonSideEffects: Changes in heart rate when the dose is excessive
precautions: Take exactly according to the prescribed instructions.
Timing and consistency of administration can affect absorption.
storage: Store at room temperature away from heat, light, and moisture.

name: Clopidogrel
description: An antiplatelet medicine that helps reduce the formation of harmful blood clots.
commonUses: Prevention of certain cardiovascular events in appropriate patients
howItWorks: It reduces the ability of platelets in the blood to stick together and form clots.
precautions: Tell healthcare professionals that this medicine is being taken before procedures or surgery.
Seek medical attention for serious or unusual bleeding.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive moisture.

name: Paracetamol
description: A medicine commonly used to relieve mild to moderate pain and reduce fever.
howItWorks: It acts primarily within the central nervous system to reduce pain and help lower elevated body temperature.
commonSideEffects: Side effects are uncommon when used appropriately
Skin reactions can occur in some people
precautions: Avoid taking more than the recommended or prescribed amount.
Check other medicines for paracetamol or acetaminophen to avoid accidentally taking multiple products containing the same ingredient.
Excessive amounts can cause serious liver injury.
storage: Store at room temperature away from excessive heat and moisture.
